title: Lotofácil 3778 Draw Yields No Winners, Jackpot Rises to R$ 5 Million
seoTitle: Lotofácil 3778: No Winners, Jackpot Climbs to R$5 Million
subtitle: The 3778 draw had no main prize winners and rolled over to the next drawing.
excerpt: In Lotofácil draw 3778, no bettor matched all 15 numbers, raising the estimated jackpot to R$ 5 million for the subsequent drawing.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On September 2nd, Lotofácil draw 3778 concluded without any top prize winners, causing the jackpot to rise to R$ 5 million for the next draw, scheduled for Thursday (3rd).

Draw 3778 Results

The numbers drawn at Espaço da Sorte, in São Paulo, were 01, 02, 03, 05, 06, 08, 09, 10, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 20, and 22. No bet matched all 15 numbers.

Rollover Jackpot and Next Draw Estimate

With no winner in the top prize tier, the accumulated amount reached R$ 1,635,769.67, raising the estimate for Thursday's draw to R$ 5 million. The total revenue for the night was R$ 19,224,653.

Distribution of Winners

193 bets matched 14 numbers, each receiving R$ 1,777.12. In the 13-match tier, 6,457 bets won R$ 35 each. There were also 83,514 bets with 12 matches (R$ 14) and 464,890 with 11 matches (R$ 7).

How to Play and Betting Options

To participate, bettors choose between 15 and 20 numbers from the 25 available. The minimum bet, with 15 numbers, costs R$ 7. Marking 12 numbers costs R$ 14, and 13 numbers costs R$ 35. Besides manual selection, Caixa offers Surpresinha (automatically chosen numbers), Teimosinha (the same bet for consecutive draws), and the option to form syndicates (bolões).

Upcoming Draws and Lotofácil Revenue

Lotofácil holds six weekly draws, from Monday to Friday at 9 PM and on Sundays at 11 AM. The prize for the next edition, estimated at R$ 5 million, includes the expected revenue from the new draw. The reserve for Lotofácil da Independência already exceeds R$ 154 million, accumulated gradually from regular draws.

With information from G1, Estadão.
